test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the extension of the tropical belt?

options.text: From equator to tropic of cancer
From equator to tropic of capricorn
From tropic of cancer to tropic of capricorn
From tropic of cancer to Arctic circle

solution:
The tropical belts include desert and semidesert landscapes on the continents and of high water temperatures and high salinity in the ocean.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• There are two important latitudes 23½°North is the tropic of Cancer and 23½°South is the tropic of Capricorn.
 
• The area lying between these two tropics is known as the tropical region. 

Thus, it is clear that from the tropic of Cancer to the tropic of Capricorn is the extension of the tropical belt.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The region lying 5 to 10 degrees, north and south of Tropic of cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn is known as Subtropical Region.
 
• Some of the areas that lie in the Subtropical region across the globe are
 
 
• ​The Northern Part of India 
 
• Parts of South America 
 
• Certain parts of Northern Australia ​ 
 
 
 
• The region between 5 to10 degree is near the Equator is called the Equatorial Region.

9d:T
